name: Urth Caffé Orange
tagline: Organic heirloom coffees, Spanish-revival courtyard, and artisanal bakery
description: Occupying an impeccably restored historic compound on West Chapman, Urth Caffe Orange is famous for its gorgeous open-air courtyard tiled with hand-painted Andalusian ceramics. Savor exclusively certified organic, heirloom coffees, Japanese green tea lattes, wood-fired artisanal pizzas, and wholesome organic breakfasts.
historicNote: Restored from the historic 1888 St. John’s Lutheran School and Church property, winning the California Preservation Foundation Preservation Design Award for its courtyard fountain and clay tile work.

specials.title: Morning Heirloom Brew Combo
specials.description: Get a fresh house-baked butter croissant or morning muffin for $3 with any large organic coffee or tea latte.

specials.title: Matcha & Tea Tuesday
specials.description: Upgrade any heirloom matcha green tea latte to organic almond or oat milk at no extra charge.

specials.title: Midweek Wood-Fired Pizza Special
specials.description: Purchase any wood-fired personal pizza and receive a complimentary side Urth garden salad.

specials.title: Organic Dessert Pairing
specials.description: Buy one signature dessert slice (Oreo cheesecake, Carrot cake, or Flourless chocolate) get second slice 50% off.

specials.title: Courtyard Sunset Teas
specials.description: Organic Moroccan mint and herbal iced teas served with house honey biscotti for $6.

specials.title: Organic Pancake Saturday
specials.description: Fluffy whole wheat buttermilk pancakes topped with organic berries and pure Vermont maple syrup.

specials.title: Sunday Morning Coffee Flight
specials.description: Tasting flight of 3 distinct single-origin pour-overs: Ethiopia, Guatemala, and Sumatra.
